seo.title: English Cocker Spaniel Breeder in Tuscany, Italy | Allevamento Cocker Montecorno
seo.description: Meet Allevamento Cocker Montecorno in Grosseto, Tuscany. Natascia has raised English Cocker Spaniels since 2005. Recognised by ENCI and FCI since 2010.

homeIntroTitle:
First, we meet.
Then, we find each other.
homeIntro: We’re Natascia and our English Cocker Spaniels. Here in Grosseto, Tuscany, we’ve shared our lives since 2005. A few litters, plenty of time together. The rest is a love story.
worldNote: Come in. Make yourself at home.

tileCaptions.puppies: The best is yet to begin.
tileCaptions.story: A passion that becomes a way of life.

homePuppyText: Puppies growing with us, new families to meet. Discover our latest litter and the next planned beginning.
